security_privacy_cost_impact: None at run time. No migration, policy, index, grant or role changes; nothing reachable by any role changes. The batch adds four lint files, four probes run by make db-migrate-clean (CI already runs it), static tests, a synthetic fixture generator and an EXPLAIN harness. Since the review round the harness and db-reset-test share one parsed test-instance guard (testHostRefusal: exact host localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1] or postgres; one @, no host list; no host, hostaddr, service or servicefile parameter), psql no longer inherits PGHOST, PGHOSTADDR, PGSERVICE or PGSERVICEFILE, and query parameter values are redacted (A1 S1, S6). The harness runs in one transaction that is rolled back, after refusing any database whose fixture tables hold rows; rolled back is not left as it was: sequences advance, reltuples stay, and dead tuples and WAL hold disk until VACUUM or the cluster is removed (A1 measured 14 -> 592 MB and 1.6 GB of disk over three runs). The fixture is synthetic by construction (derived ids, no address, no customer data). Cost: four more probes per migrate-clean (about 5.3 s measured); the harness at full WS:911 scale needs about 2 GB of free disk and has no free-space guard (open_blockers[194] (12)); the draft's full-scale run filled the volume once (plan §6.2); it was run here at small, 0.2 and 0.05 scale only.
migration_and_data_impact: NONE. Batch 150's prerequisites add no migration and need no migration number.
compatibility_impact: Additive. Tests stay 684 (no test added or renamed); foundation-contract's assertion floor 793 -> 878 -> 898, the guard's own count; test floors and name digests unchanged; the four new probe digests are pinned and, at the review round, three of them move (pinned shape b54ae8e9c8c7f6ce, policy set 3c643bfe1fcfb040, index coverage ae187b635c0ae0f4); no older digest moves. evidence/VERIFICATION.md is not amended and amends_without_owning.paths is unchanged, so no WP line citation moves. db-reset-test now refuses URLs the text match admitted (a ?host= parameter, a host list, a service); CI's postgresql://postgres@localhost:5432/thinkbizthai_test is admitted (static test). A later batch that rebuilds performance_snapshots, published_posts or usage_events (triggers included), adds or changes a vocabulary CHECK, adds a policy anywhere, or adds an RLS predicate column or lookup without a btree index of the right order must update the matching lint file in the same diff, or migrate-clean names it.
known_limitations: The pinned shapes pin no column (type, NOT NULL, default, identity) -- F7, owed to A0 with Q150-a (open_blockers[194] (4)).

Index-coverage rule 1 reads only the USING columns of a policy's own table; a helper's internal lookup and the parent lookups inside a narrowing's EXISTS are not computed -- F5, IC-2 and IC-3 (open_blockers[194] (5)). A green lookup says an index of that shape exists, not that the query plans through it (F2, A1 S5).
The vocabulary selector reads ARRAY[' and the single-column text equality; OR, regex and domain vocabularies and the other 209 CHECKs are outside it -- F6 (open_blockers[194] (6)).
The policy set reads policies, not RLS flags; enabled and forced RLS beyond the three shape tables is held by the static lint and rls-smoke -- F8.
The scripts that generated the four lint files are not in the repository -- F10.

The harness is not in CI or the Makefile, the full WS:911 scale is not measured, it has no free-space guard, and the fixture is uniform -- F13, F1, F14 (open_blockers[194] (9), (12), (11)). It needs a fresh migrate-clean database (it refuses one rls-smoke has used) and should run once per cluster.
The probes compare PostgreSQL 17.11 deparse text; CI's postgres:17 rendering identically is inferred -- F9.
Q0 mutant C10 (rule 2 counting invalid indexes) cannot be driven by a transactional migration, so it is held by a static regex only.
